about.title: About Us
about.content:
Welcome to our store. We believe in quality, design, and sustainable practices.

Founded in 2026, we aim to bring you the best curated fashion.

shipping.title: Shipping Information
shipping.content:
Rates & Times

Free standard shipping on orders over $75. Standard delivery takes 5-7 business days.

International

We ship internationally. Rates and transit times are calculated at checkout based on your destination.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: We respect your privacy and are committed to protecting your personal data. We do not sell your information to third parties.

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.content: By using this website, you agree to our terms of service and conditions of sale.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.content:
How do I return an item?

Reach out to returns@yourbrand.com within 30 days of delivery.

When will my order ship?

Orders typically process within 1-2 business days before shipping.
